protocol.name: Lemmy BDMTF agent-level intervention replay
protocol.split_rule: reuse the frozen chronological 60/20/20 split within intervention type
protocol.fit_rule: fit event intensity, author reuse, and reply targeting only on training control threads
protocol.initialization_rule: test threads are truncated at the real intervention timestamp
protocol.test_rule: compare paired simulated intervention/no-intervention event paths with observed matched-pair DID effects
protocol.reporting_rule: retain every outcome, baseline, confidence interval, null result, and opposite-direction result
